confirmed_findings.finding: Omitting the optional GALAM variant dispatch preserves legacy GALAM state and predictions.

confirmed_findings.finding: Variant configuration now reports effective topology, rejects noncanonical inactive local-only fields, and makes active fusion order explicit so changed ordering cannot be silently ignored.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review and the variant/runtime/component test group.

confirmed_findings.finding: Monitor identity and resume checkpoint validation now use data.monitoring_plan consistently and require both event offsets for monitored resumes.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Test added for accepting monitored offsets and rejecting their absence; root reports integrated targeted suite passed.

confirmed_findings.finding: Resume now applies safe checkpoint offsets before parsing evaluation history, allowing orphan partial JSONL tails to be preserved and truncated. Appends are gated until restore completes.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review and partial-tail/safe-offset tests in the monitoring suite.

confirmed_findings.finding: Evaluation history has count/byte limits and the generic monitor event journal has a 1 GiB bound.
confirmed_findings.limitation: When the generic event journal reaches its cap, appending raises and the monitored fit stops; there is no rotation or drop-with-warning policy.

confirmed_findings.finding: Monitoring verifies exact source-qualified membership and requires the official is_scored mask for both train-eval and valid reporting cohorts before claiming complete coverage.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Current root worktree changes enforce the mask for both cohorts and add two parametrized rejection cases; root reports targeted suite passed.

confirmed_findings.finding: A cohort with official scored rows but zero total target weight reports zero weighted loss and preserves official WP=0 semantics instead of aborting the fit.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Zero-target-weight test present; root reports targeted suite passed.

confirmed_findings.finding: Monitored full fits record no_eval_during_fit=false and report-only validation with no checkpoint selection. Bounded profiles record no_eval_during_fit=true and say validation was not evaluated.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review of fit/profile/checkpoint provenance and monitor status context.

confirmed_findings.finding: The resource sampler is wired into sampled monitor events. It records process/host/disk readings and queries NVIDIA sensors only with a validated physical or MIG UUID; unavailable readings are omitted.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review. Root reports six mocked resource tests passed.

confirmed_findings.finding: A separate bounded evaluation journal preserves sparse epoch reports in the dashboard, avoids interpolation by drawing recorded points, and exposes when training or evaluation history is windowed.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review. Root reports dashboard/API tests and browser QA with sparse evaluation records and 12,000 dense events passed.

confirmed_findings.status: step-order correction closed in bd45e50f; elapsed axis limitation remains explicit
confirmed_findings.finding: Elapsed x uses wall time from the first retained event, so it includes pauses and resume downtime and can be affected by host clock correction. The current event merge sorts by wall_time; root plans to sort merged history by step for clock corrections.
confirmed_findings.limitation: Epoch and step axes are durable. Elapsed wall time includes pauses and resume downtime; a host clock correction can still make elapsed x values discontinuous or nonmonotone even though merged event order follows step. No persisted monotonic elapsed-since-run counter exists across resume.

confirmed_findings.finding: Dashboard now has default panels for output-volume free bytes and filesystem used percentage; both were previously available only through the custom metric selector.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Current root worktree adds disk/free_bytes and disk/used_pct metric groups.

confirmed_findings.finding: Opt-in monitoring is now initialized for bounded profiles and the actual SequenceMonitor is routed through train_epoch, so train-step, sampled diagnostics, and resources are exercised. The profile path makes no valid evaluation calls and writes no model/training checkpoint.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review plus new profile routing test verifies train/diagnostic/resource callbacks, zero evaluate_epoch calls, profile statuses, and receipt no_eval_during_fit=true.

confirmed_findings.finding: Monitored profile updates must reach diagnostics_every_steps, ensuring at least one sampled hook window.
confirmed_findings.evidence: The check exists before distributed initialization and is repeated in run_profile.

confirmed_findings.finding: On Windows, the optional resource import yields no host RSS value. The profile receipt can represent this as null, but validate_profile_receipt still requires positive integer host RSS, so that receipt cannot admit a full fit.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Static review of _host_peak_rss_bytes and validate_profile_receipt; no Windows GPU profile was executed.
